summary: Iteration-3 testing covers: (1) renamed seeded users Murat/Özkan with new .local emails, (2) monthly-report cron endpoint + preview + send-now, (3) FilterBar (search + month-year dropdown) across Gelirler/Giderler/Faturalar/Harcamalar, (4) Harcamalar tab labels, (5) brand rename to 'Karivo Otomotiv'. Backend: 33/33 pytest passed, 1 skipped (low-stock no-items case). All auth, cron, and filter endpoints behave per spec. Frontend: Login page shows 'Karivo Otomotiv' brand with quick-login buttons Murat/Özkan, correct emails. Topbar + sidebar branding correct. Harcamalar shows 3 tabs 'Şirket Harcamaları', 'Murat Harcamaları', 'Özkan Harcamaları' with per-tab filter state (spending-company-search / spending-company-month-filter present). Gelirler/Giderler/Faturalar each expose data-testids {income|expense|invoice}-search and {income|expense|invoice}-month-filter. Month dropdown lists 'Tüm Zamanlar (N)' + one option per month with record count (verified: 'Tüm Zamanlar (2)', 'Ekim 2026 (2)' on Gelirler). Search box filters rows (xyznotexisting → 1 result row shown placeholder → 2 after clear; empty-state row). Settings dialog opens and lists both users with notification_email inputs. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: The actual Resend email send inside _run_monthly_report_task likely fails for @karivo.local recipients (fake domain) — expected and documented in request. Endpoint still acks 200 quickly as required.

issues: Legacy records still show 'Added by: Ahmet (Kullanıcı 1)' for incomes created by the previous seed user. Not a bug — historical added_by string stored on the record — but may confuse users. Consider migrating added_by on old records or hiding user-tagged display for pre-migration rows.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1327 lines — overdue to split into routers (auth/finance/inventory/email/reports/dashboard).

cron_monthly_report uses an in-memory _processed_webhooks set with pop() for size limit (not FIFO; set.pop() removes arbitrary element). Fine for 500 cap but not deterministic — consider a bounded deque for predictable eviction, or Mongo-backed idempotency keys so idempotency survives server restarts.

_run_monthly_report_task runs as a FastAPI BackgroundTask (same event loop). If Resend hangs, it could affect subsequent requests. Consider timeouts on httpx client and/or a real queue if volume grows.

/api/cron/monthly-report returns {ok,run_id,queued} even when WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET is unset (actually it raises 401 if expected is empty — good). But envelope JSON parsing failures are silently swallowed; harmless but worth logging.

notification_email field uses EmailStr while LoginIn.email was correctly loosened to str — users with @karivo.local cannot save their own email as notification_email (expected per note). UI should hint 'gerçek e-posta gerekir' which the Settings dialog already does ✓.
